content.short: Nalikes Studio is a full-stack blockchain development agency that provides blockchain development services and builds Web3 products.
content.description: Nalikes Studio specializes in Web3 development, partnering with businesses, brands, and digital creators to help them enter, build, and scale within the Web3 ecosystem. The studio provides an NFT launchpad, Metaverse solutions, and a reusable dApps component library to accelerate product delivery, improve adoption, and empower teams to innovate with confidence. Their focus is to create lasting engagement, practical utility, and enduring value for Web3 communities across multiple networks and use cases.
